goal: Coordinate reviewed microphone input, final-answer-only auto-read and one shared TTS owner while exposing a low-noise stateful AI breath in the canvas HUD.
non_goals: Do not auto-send speech recognition results or auto-read keyboard-origin prompts.
Do not speak partial streaming tokens or add a separate voice panel.
Do not change Task 11 generation transactions, Task 12 transcript/draft windowing, retrieval, AI permissions, credentials or recovery.
acceptance_criteria: Prompt origin is attached to one outgoing request; keyboard prompts stay silent and microphone prompts auto-read one final answer exactly once.
Starting speech, changing canvas/session, collapsing the HUD or starting new playback stops the shared current TTS owner.
Speech recognition fills the composer for review and never auto-sends.
AI breath maps listening, thinking, retrieval, location, management, editing, confirmation, completion and failure states using transform/opacity/blur only and respects reduced motion.
TTS failure leaves final text visible and manual/automatic read-aloud share stopCurrentAudio.
Focused tests, Canvas regression, TypeScript, production build and diff checks pass.
Implementation is committed, independently reviewed and passes the L2 post-edit impact gate.
do_not_touch: canvas geometry, collision or rich-media modules
remote repositories before the Phase C push gate
notes: Use test-first implementation and keep review/report evidence concise.
Associate microphone origin with the outgoing request after user review, not with ambient microphone state.
Reuse stopCurrentAudio and preserve visible text on all audio failures.
Use fixed UTF-8 I/O for non-ASCII reads and edits.
Never inspect, print, log or modify configured provider secrets.
